item.description:
Version: 1.0
Author: Equendil
Category: LotRO Tools & Utilities for Developers
Updated: 2011-07-11 19:41 UTC
Downloads: 25,176
File: HereBeDragons1_0.zip (17.0 KB)

About

Here Be Dragons is a a plugin that lets the curious developer browse the global lua environment _G in LotRO with a graphical user interface.

Ultimately Here Be Dragons is simply an interactive table dump. Developers can use the browser independently of the plugin itself to explore their own data structures at run time or find out more about those undocumented "args" Turbines API sends as parameter to events.

item.title: API Table Dump (1.0)
item.description:
Version: 1.0
Author: Galuhad
Category: LotRO Tools & Utilities for Developers
Updated: 2011-07-05 15:53 UTC
Downloads: 26,312
File: APIDump.rar (1.4 KB)

This is a really straightforward plugin designed to help other developers with an overview of the table structures for each of the APIs. Just type in the location of the table you want to view eg. Turbine.Gameplay.Actor and hit dump to view the table. It takes the tables directly from the game so it will not need updating as new APIs are added.
